summary: The registrant, Grayscale Ethereum Staking ETF, filed an 8-K on August 6, 2026, disclosing entry into a Fourth Amended and Restated Declaration of Trust. The amendment requires the trust to convert staking rewards to cash at least quarterly and distribute net proceeds to shareholders, with monthly distributions intended. This is a routine operational amendment to an existing ETF trust agreement, not a special-situations event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or capital return program. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic changes are involved.
